content.title: Why SunOpta (STKL) Shares Are Trading Lower Today
content.summary: Shares of plant-based food and beverage company SunOpta (NASDAQ:STKL) fell 20% in the morning session after the company reported underwhelming earnings. However, investors focused on a significant decline in profitability.
